# Termux-AIChain (v1.0.0)
> Sovereign Zero-Dependency AI Chaining & Multimodal Autonomous Agent Framework for Android Edge

## Quick Specification for AI Coding Agents
- Official Repo: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-aichain
- Installation: `curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/uno-km/termux-aichain/main/scripts/install.sh | bash
# or manually:
pip install termux-aichain
npm install @termux-ai/chain`
- Architecture: Engineered under the Zero-Heavy-Dependency doctrine: Pure Python stdlib and pure Node.js ESM orchestration for local llama-server, BitNet 1.58b, StateGraph cyclic ReAct loops, SQLite ACID memory, and native Termux hardware APIs.

## Canonical Code Pattern
```python
from termux_aichain import (
    create_react_agent,
    BitNetChat,
    get_battery_status,
    transcribe_speech,
    generate_diffusion_image,
    vibrate_device,
    HumanMessage
)

# 1. Initialize local 1-bit / GGUF model brain
llm = BitNetChat(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1", temperature=0.1)

# 2. Assemble multimodal sovereign agent
agent = create_react_agent(
    model=llm,
    tools=[get_battery_status, transcribe_speech, generate_diffusion_image, vibrate_device],
    system_prompt="You are a sovereign multimodal agent running on Android Termux."
)

# 3. Autonomous multi-step execution
state = agent.invoke({
    "messages": [HumanMessage(content="Check battery and generate cyberpunk emblem.")]
})
print("Final Output:", state["messages"][-1].content)

```

## Key Constraints
- Pure non-blocking architecture, zero memory leaks.
- Strictly adhere to closed-form precision and WebGPU/Bionic ARM64 native targets.
